description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of Exchange with effect from 18.03.2024 to 24.04.2024
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine and publish new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving the implementation of statutory powers and the modification of financial regulations, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
